This is an anticipatory bail moved on behalf of the petitioner in relation to F.I.R. No.08/2024 of Police Station Sheoganj District Sirohi registered for the offence punishable under Sections(s) 420,
406 and 120-B of I.P.C.
2.
I have appreciated the submissions advanced by the learned defence counsel and learned Public Prosecutor and have carefully perused the material available on record.

During the investigation it has been found that the conspiracy was raised by Tarun Pal Singh, Dharmendra Singh and Narpat Singh and out of the consideration petitioner Dharmendra Singh got Rs.10,00,000/-.
It is observed that the petitioner herein is involved in a serious crime.

The investigation is still in process and the petitioner herein is evading arrest by not joining the Dharamendra Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:28771) on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174034241/

sentences.text: Thus, the chance of the petitioner escaping the procedure of law, tampering with the evidence or threatening the complainant exists.

The investigation conducted further revealed that during the investigation, the statement of the victim was recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C wherein the victim has alleged specific allegations qua petitioner.

5. In my view, since the case is at the threshold and the investigations are underway, it will be practically scuttling the investigation in case the anticipatory bail is granted to the petitioner which will create hurdles in arriving at the truth.

6. In view of the aforesaid settled principles, the facts and circumstances of the present case, and the case set up against petitioner in its entirety, the allegations leveled against the petitioner this Court is of prima facie opinion that it is not a fit case for grant of pre-arrest bail to petitioner.
The Court is not inclined to grant the anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
7. Resultantly, instant application for anticipatory bail is devoid of merit and accordingly dismissed.

Whatever discussed [2024:RJ-JD:28771] (4 of 4) [CRLMB-4816/2024] or observed hereinabove is only a prima facie view and shall not tantamount to any opinion on the merits of the case.
